svg.title: CopyTrading: from a trader’s post to a traceable order
svg.desc: Discord capture, evidence-grounded model interpretation, parallel account risk checks, Alpaca orders, broker reconciliation and lot history. Owner controls use a separate approval path.

g.text: From a trader’s post to a traceable order
Every lot links to its post
Skipped or review-required signals are recorded; no order is placed.
Review evidence → correct interpretation → fresh preview
